name: Vexholme
description: There is no surface, only an endless fall through banded clouds: amber belts, cream zones, and storms wide enough to swallow worlds. Lightning flickers between the layers like thoughts of a vast mind.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
buried megastructure still shows toolmarks half-finished. Whatever called everyone away did not give them time to say goodbye.
Whoever controls antimatter traces controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
